name: Sotrama Settings

fields.label: Company Registration Details
fields.description: Optional Algerian registration fields for Company. ERPNext's standard Tax ID remains the NIF field.

fields.label: Enable Algerian Company Registration Fields
fields.description: When enabled, Sotrama adds Article d'imposition, NIS, RC and Capital Social to Algerian Company records. NIF continues to use ERPNext's standard Tax ID field. Disabling this option hides Sotrama-managed fields but preserves their metadata and values.

fields.label: Import BTPH Job Titles into Frappe HR
fields.description: Optional one-time creation of the company's French job-title catalogue in the standard Frappe HR Designation master. No separate Sotrama employee or job-title register is created.

fields.label: Create Missing BTPH Designation Records
fields.description: When checked and saved, Sotrama creates only missing entries from the curated 202-title French BTPH list in Frappe HR > Human Resources > Employee > Designation. This creates job-title master records only; it does not create Employees, Drivers or employee assignments. Existing designations are never renamed, overwritten or deleted.

description: Central application settings and optional feature activation for all Sotrama modules.
